slug: 2024-03-11 Republic of Congo launches Pointe-Noire data centre for 2Africa cable

facts.fact: DCD reports President Sassou N'Guesso activated Congo's connection to the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire on 28 February 2024.
DCD reports the 2Africa landing at Pointe-Noire is near the existing WACS station, so two cables are in service at the same landing area.

systems.owner: consortium (Meta, Telecom Egypt, China Mobile, MTN GlobalConnect, Orange, STC, Vodafone, WIOCC)
